thread:
Alex: Proposal to reduce SIEM raw-export retention in S3 from 400d -> 90d to lower PII blast radius and storage cost. Need a JIT preserve/unlock runbook for IR/legal + KMS unwrap guidance and audit trail.
Maria: Strong preference to use S3 Object Lock for preserved copies. Tag objects with x-case-id so controller can promote to locked copy on approval.
Jon: Our SOC partner still needs long-tail access. Suggest we produce a masked/aggregated partner export kept 365d and keep raw only 90d.
Sam: KMS pattern: envelope encryption with our CMK, no long-lived decrypt keys. Create per-request, timeboxed KMS grants tied to ticket id and approver. Record GrantCreate/Decrypt in CloudTrail and emit an indexed security-log entry for the unwrap. Use SSO-proxy to mint presigned URLs.
Legal: If we receive subpoenas we may need COMPLIANCE Object Lock. Legal wants exact ticket template + approval language before signoff.
security-automation: Ticket created SEC-6111 "SIEM export retention + preserve/unlock playbook" https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SEC-6111
Alex: Next steps: open PR with architecture + OPA snippets + ticket template, run a 2-week canary moving low-value indices to 90d, and build automated tests: expiry deny -> preserved-case allow with audit. I'll start the PR today and post to SEC-6111.
